'''Miner droids''' were [[Droid/Legends|automatons]] used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eos]]. The droids [[Mining/Legends|mined]] Eos for the [[Droid factory (Eos)|droid factory]] there.<ref name="SW:SF" /> The droids were oval-shaped and followed set routes.<ref name="SW:SF guide">[[Star Wars: Starfighter: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Starfighter'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Vana Sage]] [[Skirmish at Eos|encountered]] the droids after escaping a Trade Federation contract infringement.<ref name="SW:SF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The miner droids appear in mission 4 of the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]. In that mission, the player has the option of hunting down all eight to destroy them and fulfill the bonus objective, although doing so does not affect the storyline.
